opening_title: `--doctest-modules` option causes namespace packages' subpackages to be added to `sys.path`

expected_outcome.rationale: Doctest-induced sys.path insertion and import conflicts differ from --pyargs resolving separate namespace eggs. The opening asks whether the observed behavior is expected and supplies layout, example, package list, pytest version and macOS release. Question is accepted; bug remains a plausible interpretation of the conflict.
